title: Standing forward fold

steps.text: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
steps.cue: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.

steps.text: Bend your knees a little and fold forward from your hips.
steps.cue: Soft knees. Fold forward from your hips.

steps.text: Let your head and arms hang heavy toward the floor.
steps.cue: Let your head and arms hang heavy.

steps.text: Stay for a few slow breaths, then roll up slowly one bit at a time.
steps.cue: Breathe slowly, then roll up a bit at a time.

mistakes: Standing up fast and getting light-headed.
regression: Bend your knees more and rest your hands on your thighs.
stopIf: Come up slowly if you feel dizzy or your lower back hurts.

anatomy.why: Hanging forward from the hips lengthens the whole back of the legs.
